
Citation
========

If using ``GWDALI`` please cite the release papers bellow

Release papers
--------------

Here you find the :math:`{\rm BibT}_{\rm \Large E}{\rm X}` records of the release papers

.. code-block:: bibtex

  @article{de2023gwdali,
    title={GWDALI: Gravitational wave parameter estimation},
    author={de Souza, Josiel Mendon{\c{c}}a Soares and Sturani, Riccardo},
    journal={Astrophysics Source Code Library},
    pages={ascl--2307},
    year={2023}
    }


.. code-block:: bibtex

  @article{de2026use,
    title={On the use of the Derivative Approximation for Likelihoods for gravitational wave inference},
    author={de Souza, Josiel Mendon{\c{c}}a Soares and Quartin, Miguel},
    journal={Journal of Cosmology and Astroparticle Physics},
    volume={2026},
    number={05},
    pages={101},
    year={2026},
    publisher={IOP Publishing}
    }
